facts: Level.setBlock calls markAndNotifyBlock before returning true. Flags2 suppress bit1 neighbor notifications but do not suppress bit16 shape updates.
markAndNotifyBlock invokes neighbor shape propagation with flags2 & -34 =0. NeighborUpdater executeShapeUpdate reaches Block.updateOrDestroy and recursive setBlock.

CollectingNeighborUpdater drains queued updates synchronously; IronBarsBlock changes pane connection properties. A just-placed pane can therefore keep its block type but have different properties before setBlock returns.
Guard must validate exact incoming template state and true native acceptance, then retain block identity; full post-return state equality can falsely reject native construction.
MinimalMC regression places a default black glass pane east withflags18, then a default pane atorigin withflags2; acceptedtrue, sameblockidentity, changedproperties are checked.
